example_zh: 在子宫肌壁中出现粗厚和海绵状的团块,这是子宫腺肌病的典型表现.

meaning_zh: n.自发性，自然发生,自发行为[行动]
example_en: But sexual attraction is based on spontaneity, unpredictability and, to Obama point, a little mystery.
example_zh: 但是性的吸引力却是自发的 、 不可预见的, 对于奥巴马来说, 也有些许的神秘.

meaning_zh: adj.自发的,自然的,天然产生的,无意识的
example_en: Objective To cure various clinical manifestation of spontaneous pneumothorax ( SP ) through various measures.
example_zh: 目的通过对多种自发性气胸的临床表现采用不同的治疗方法,达到治愈的效果.

meaning_zh: adv.自然地，自发地，不由自主地,不禁,油然
example_en: He was never spontaneously warm or friendly towards us.
example_zh: 他从未自然而然地对我们表示过热情或友好。

meaning_zh: n.（对电影、电视节目等的）滑稽模仿
v.滑稽地模仿（电影、电视节目等）,（冒用他人电邮地址）发送电邮；发送仿真电邮；电邮欺骗
example_en: You can watch a clip of the spoof by clicking here.
example_zh: 你可以点击这里观看一段片段.

meaning_zh: adj.不定时发生的，时有时无的,零星的，分散的,哩哩啦啦
example_en: Outbreaks and sporadic human infection with swine influenza have been occasionally reported.
example_zh: 人感染猪流感病毒的暴发和散发病例时有报导.

example_en: So nike shoes really conformable for the athletes and sport lovers.
example_zh: 因此，耐克鞋非常适合运动员和运动爱好者。

meaning_zh: adj.运动的,爱好文体活动的,公正的,好赌博的
example_en: What I mean to say is, you are on the map. You have a sporting chance.
example_zh: 我的意思是, 你已经有地位了, 很有成功的可能.

example_en: The first prize was awarded to the best competitor of the annual sports meeting.
example_zh: 头奖颁给了这一年一度的运动会上最优秀的运动员。

example_en: He needs a new pair of sandals and sports shoes.
example_zh: 他需要一双新凉鞋和一双新运动鞋。

example_en: Our sports star today is Jack.
example_zh: 我们今天的运动明星是杰克。

example_en: Sportspeople, musicians and public speakers can all benefit from better posture.
example_zh: 运动员、音乐家和演说家都可以从更好的姿势中受益。

example_en: Have you ever watched a top sportsperson in action and wondered to yourself at how easy she makes it look?
example_zh: 在见到顶级水平的运动员的表现，你是否想过她会让比赛变得如此轻松？

example_en: My room is spotless.
example_zh: 我的房间一尘不染。

example_en: The University of Tennessee's Walters Life Sciences building, is a model animal facility, spotlessly clean, careful in obtaining prior approval for experiments from an animal care committee.
example_zh: 田纳西大学的沃尔特斯生命科学大楼，一尘不染，是一座典型的动物实验楼，在获得动物委员会对实验的事先批准方面十分谨慎。

meaning_zh: adj.有斑点的,有污点的,弄脏的,〈口〉受注意的
v.发现,弄上污痕（spot的过去分词）
example_en: The night sky is spotted with stars.
example_zh: 夜晚的天空繁星点点.

meaning_zh: n.喷口，喷嘴,水柱，喷流,（鲸类的）喷水孔,[气]龙卷
vt.& vi.喷出,喷射,滔滔不绝地讲,把…典当掉
vi.喷出,喷射,滔滔不绝地讲
example_en: The spout is chipped so it doesn't pour very well.
example_zh: 这壶嘴儿有个豁口,倒起来不方便.
